meta_description:
94K likes, 3,865 comments - neetimohan18 on October 17, 2026: "With profound grief and a heavy heart, we regret to share the sad demise of our beloved father, Mr Brij Mohan Sharma who left for his heavenly abode on 15.10.2026 

A loving husband and a father, a guiding light, and the pillar of our family. His wisdom, kindness, values, and unconditional love will forever remain in our hearts. Though he is no longer with us, his blessings, teachings, and beautiful memories will continue to guide us throughout our lives.

His absence has left a void that can never be filled, but his love will live on in our hearts forever.

May his noble soul rest in eternal peace.

We will miss you Papa 🙏🏼".
